name: Cislunar-Strath
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around massive canyon systems, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
